summary: Second authenticated cold read (gpt-6-sol, read-only) after the GPT-6 model migration returned three gaps and three contradictions. All six were answerable from repository facts; none required escalation. One finding corrected a factual error the previous revision of this plan had asserted about AC16.
gaps: The effective write scope does not cover four files already changed since the stated base: `factory/scripts/check_agents_hygiene.py`, `factory/scripts/forge_cli/context.py`, `factory/scripts/forge_cli/quickfix.py`, and `factory/scripts/forge_cli/story.py`. None appears in the recorded scope or eight amendments (`.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/task-plans/LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:180-334`). The story plan assigns resume work involving `story.py` to Shared (`plans/active/FORGE-COORD-1-either-claude-or-codex-coordinates-the-same-forge-workflow.md:153-156`), yet this plan depends on a story-resume repair (`LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:126-131`). The handover does not say how these changes become authorized or leave Lean.

AC16 and AC17 still have no required test or verify command that checks the benchmark arithmetic, adoption thresholds, setup-share predicate, or retained fixture coverage (`.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/decomposition.json:780-788,1065-1078`). Historical timings and conclusions are free-form `tests.json` entries (`.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/tasks/LEAN-WORKFLOW/tests.json:63-73`; `factory/schemas/test-automated.json:6-18`), so the declared proof cannot falsify an incorrect adoption decision.

The task now spans 132 product files and 32,873 added-plus-deleted lines against a recorded 28,500-line review budget (`.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/decomposition.json:1082-1085`). The plan calls the overrun a note (`LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:106-111`) but gives no smaller reviewable shape or specific reason this remains one bounded implementation and review, as required by `constitution/09-agent-conduct.md:21-33`.
contradictions: AC8 requires the complete sixteen-role registry while the authoritative recorded objective and matching criterion still require only three Forge-owned profiles (`.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/task-plans/LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:62,158,169`; `.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/decomposition.json:533,546`). The plan acknowledges that decomposition must be amended but presents the incompatible contract as the current handover. Decision 0080 and the named required test require the full registry (`docs/decisions/0080-native-role-model-routing.md:54-59`; `factory/tests/test_native_setup.py:456-472`).

The plan claims agreement with accepted decisions through 0082 (`LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:8,17,66`), but accepted Decision 0080 pins GPT-5.6 Luna, Terra, and Sol (`docs/decisions/0080-native-role-model-routing.md:23-32`), while current profiles and `harness.yaml` pin GPT-6 Luna and Sol (`.codex/agents/explorer.toml:3`; `.codex/agents/worker.toml:3`; `harness.yaml:26-33`). The plan names no superseding authority for that model-routing change.

The plan says AC16 holds by non-adoption and that the canonical worker count remains `-n 4` (`LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:113-116`). The current verifier command is `-n 8` (`.envrc:20`), and the task's recorded benchmark explicitly says to adopt eight workers (`.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/tasks/LEAN-WORKFLOW/tests.json:63-70`). Its verification step also orders a 4/6/8 benchmark (`LEAN-WORKFLOW.md:135-136`), contradicting the claimed no-benchmark disposition.
resolutions: Named all four out-of-scope files in the plan -- check_agents_hygiene.py, forge_cli/context.py, forge_cli/story.py and forge_cli/quickfix.py -- and the route that authorises them:  at stage done, which exists for measured paths a task touched but did not declare. quickfix.py was already changed on the branch before the handover. The story.py change is the narrow approval-binding repair  itself demanded, not Shared's broader resume feature.

The benchmark evidence exists and is specific (medians, percentages, adoption verdict) in the task's tests.json, so the adoption decision is auditable. What is missing is a MACHINE-CHECKABLE assertion, because test-automated.json accepts free-form command and summary strings. A benchmark-shaped evidence schema is a NEW evidence schema, which this task's scope explicitly excludes, so it is carried as a named follow-up rather than silently claimed as covered.

Recorded why this stays one bounded implementation: native approval, removal of the formats it replaces, the one-time migration of those formats, and the close-owned proof path are mutually dependent, and landing them separately would ship a half-migrated harness that refuses its own recorded evidence in between. The reviewable shape is bounded by the Decision 0078 parallel-group review, which splits the diff for reading without splitting the change.

Already dispositioned in the previous revision and unchanged: the rendered contract Objective still says 'three-profile Forge registry reduction' and requires a decomposition amendment through record_decomposition_from_json.py. The plan states this and deliberately does not hand-edit the rendered contract block. The tree, Decision 0080 and the named required test all agree on the sixteen-role registry.

Named the superseding authority: docs/decisions/0083-native-role-model-routing-on-gpt-6.md, drafted with the GPT-6 change and PROPOSED pending owner acceptance in chat. Until it is accepted the tree and 0080 disagree, and the plan now names that disagreement rather than implying agreement.

CORRECTED a factual error this plan previously asserted. AC16 does NOT hold by non-adoption: the 4/6/8 comparison was run and recorded (medians n4 186.099s, n6 177.336s, n8 153.966s; n8 17.27% faster, both runs passing, 5.97% apart, inside the 15% limit), the gate passed, and the canonical worker count moved to -n 8, which .envrc:20 runs today. AC17 does hold by non-adoption with its predicate recorded: profiled setup share below 25% in both baselines.

artifact_delta.cold:
AC16 and AC17 hold by NON-ADOPTION and owe no benchmark: `factory/tests/conftest.py`
is untouched on this branch, so no shared fixture optimisation was introduced,
and nothing in the tree sets a worker count other than the canonical `-n 4`.
Adopting either optimisation would require the recorded 4/6/8 comparison first.
artifact_delta.final:
AC16 holds by ADOPTION WITH RECORDED EVIDENCE, not by non-adoption. An earlier
revision of this plan claimed the opposite and was wrong. The 4/6/8 comparison
was run and is recorded in
`.factory/stories/FORGE-COORD-1/tasks/LEAN-WORKFLOW/tests.json`: medians n4
186.099s, n6 177.336s, n8 153.966s. n8 was 17.27% faster than n4, both n8 runs
passed, and their timings differed by 5.97% of the median, inside the 15%
repeatability limit. The adoption gate therefore passed and the canonical worker
count moved to `-n 8`, which is what `.envrc:20` runs today.

AC17 holds by NON-ADOPTION with its predicate recorded: profiled setup share was
below 25% in both baselines, so no prepared fixture was attempted or adopted, and
`factory/tests/conftest.py` is untouched on this branch.

What neither criterion has is a MACHINE-CHECKABLE assertion.
`factory/schemas/test-automated.json` accepts free-form command and summary
strings, so the recorded medians and the adoption verdict are auditable prose
rather than something a gate can falsify. Adding a benchmark-shaped evidence
schema is a real gap, but it is a new evidence schema, which this task's scope
explicitly excludes; it is carried as a follow-up rather than silently claimed.

handover. None appears in the 134 base entries or the 8 recorded amendments, so

which is the supported route for measured paths a task touched but did not
declare. The story plan assigns Shared the broader resume work; this task's
`story.py` change is the narrow approval-binding repair that `stage start`
itself demanded, not that feature.

current_flow: Present the compact exact plan through Claude ExitPlanMode, consume its real digest-bound approval, delegate focused implementation and regression fixes, and run close as the single final proof owner. If functional evidence is requested, record it and rerun close; then poll current-head CI and merge under existing authority.
